passages.provision_quote: Except for a form produced by the United States election assistance commission, any application for registration shall be accompanied by satisfactory evidence of citizenship as prescribed in section 16-166, subsection F, and the county recorder or other officer in charge of elections shall reject any application for registration that is not accompanied by satisfactory evidence of citizenship.
passages.note: Chaptered text of HB2492 prints the operative proof-of-citizenship-at-registration requirement but names no actor.
Bill overview shows Hoffman as prime sponsor of the 2022 House bill, an act taken before he held this Senate seat.
House Third Reading vote page records his Aye and the divided tally; the page prints no provision text.

rows.reasoning: Every passage is HB 2492 (2022), which Hoffman prime-sponsored and voted for as a member of the Arizona House; its operative text requires that an "application for registration shall be accompanied by satisfactory evidence of citizenship", matching "Require documentary proof of citizenship to register to vote." But the act dates from February–March 2022, before his State Senate term began on 2023-01-02, so under V5 it is pre-seating and valid only for the House office. No passage survives V1–V5 for this seat.
